text: AC18 is now derived rather than guessed: measured 37ms for pending and 251ms for verify and gate on this repository, stable to within 5ms over five runs, so 100ms is under half a typical verify and cannot dominate it. The previous two seconds was eight times a whole verify and admitted in the same sentence to being a guess — a number that would have made the tool feel broken, written into a criterion, in a repository whose subject is asserting things without evidence
